statement: A MessageRouter connection that misses keepalive PONGs but has fresh parsed inbound traffic from the same peer remains connected, while a genuinely silent half-open peer is still severed and redialed; with that invariant active, the production five-node MovieLens milestone reaches authoritative pre-schema quiescence, durable ratings CREATE, ratings preload, 100000 loaded rows, ratings-only split convergence, and a successful three-way report without weakening the full evaluation-window admission gate.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Recent inbound traffic may suppress keepalive teardown only within the existing bounded liveness window; a silent half-open peer must still be severed and redialed.
Do not widen the schema budget, weaken the 60000ms quiescence window, serialize scenario joins, reduce production logging, or rerun live without a changed deterministic owner invariant.
